node.title: Re: Escaping Apostrophe
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
My first suggestion is to not re-invent the wheel, see for example [mod://SQL::Abstract] (Update: [id://1168493|example]).

Also, you should always use [http://metacpan.org/pod/DBI#Placeholders-and-Bind-Values|placeholders] wherever possible - see [http://bobby-tables.com/|Bobby Tables]!

[mod://DBI] provides quote and quote_identifier, but I'd consider those a last resort if the above is not applicable for whatever unlikely reason.
